# Public transit

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(qrspike)
library(plotly)
source("data.R")

transit    <- transit_data()
sd_transit <- qr_shared(transit, ~code, "gemeente")
```

Share of households within 500 m of a bus stop.

```{r}
#| echo: false
qr_iconfill(transit, key = "code", value = "pct_near_stop", label = "name", param = "gemeente")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_ly(sd_transit, x = ~name, y = ~pct_near_stop, type = "bar")
```
